rules.name: Medical Claims Evidence
rules.text: All medical or efficacy claims must be backed by clinical evidence.

rules.name: Absolute Guarantees
rules.text: Avoid absolute or unsupported promotional guarantees.
rules.fix: Use measured language, e.g. 'helps improve the look of skin'.

rules.name: Accessibility
rules.text: Avoid ALL-CAPS runs and require image alt text.

knowledge.title: Tone
knowledge.text: Our tone is warm, honest and expert. We never pressure customers.

knowledge.title: Claims policy
knowledge.text: Efficacy claims need clinical evidence on file. Never promise to cure skin conditions.

knowledge.title: Promotions policy
knowledge.text: Discounts are capped at 20 percent. Seasonal offers need marketing approval.

knowledge.title: Logo usage
knowledge.text: Keep clear space around the logo. Never recolour or stretch it.
